decisions.reason: This dismantling joint is close to the firm’s core pipeline and valve business, uses existing fabrication and certification capabilities, and is inexpensive to keep as a live option while demand in water infrastructure remains favorable.

The plain powder-coated public waste bin is a more generic and less core-adjacent diversification play, and after several years the firm would likely reallocate attention and capacity if clear strategic traction has not emerged.
The waste bin with ashtray is the most differentiated of the municipal street-furniture products and is worth keeping a bit longer as a relatively low-cost option on public-sector demand.
The standalone outdoor ashtray is a narrow, peripheral offering with overlap to product E, so real-options logic favors closing this weaker option and focusing resources elsewhere.
